items.title: Embracing Observability for the AI era at re:Invent 2026
items.summary: As organizations continue to scale their cloud presence and bring AI agents into production, effective operations become increasingly critical for success. The AWS re:Invent 2026 Cloud Operations track brings together industry experts, AWS leaders, and customers to share how they modernize monitoring and observability for applications and the AI agents now running alongside them.
